title: Platform settings
description: Every runtime setting the platform reads, with who changed it, when and why. Secrets stay in deploy configuration; this console only says whether they are configured.

general.label: General
general.description: Maintenance mode, the support address, and what a new workspace starts with.

security.label: Security & auth
security.description: Session lifetimes, password policy, lockout, sign-in rate limits and Google sign-in. Changing these needs the settings.security permission.

meetings.label: Meetings & AI pipeline
meetings.description: Transcription, AI suggestions, voice cloning and recording — with the language catalog and the consent ledger below as reference.

billing.label: Billing
billing.description: Trials, the billing policy (VAT) and pricing economics.

notifications.label: Notifications & email
notifications.description: Who transactional e-mail comes from and where replies go.

limits.label: Limits & quotas
limits.description: Upload sizes and rate limits. Some can be raised for one plan or one workspace with an override.

retention.label: Data & retention
retention.description: What the platform keeps, and what deletes it today.

integrations.label: Integrations
integrations.description: External services: whether each is configured, connection tests, and deploy-time configuration. Secrets are never shown.

feature_flags.label: Feature flags
feature_flags.description: Kill switches and gradual rollouts. A flag that is off is off for everyone, whatever its allow lists say.

nav.changedCount: {count, plural, one {# setting changed from its default} other {# settings changed from their defaults}}

search.placeholder: Search settings by name, key, description or service
search.results: {count, plural, one {# setting matches} other {# settings match}} “{query}” across all categories
search.changedOnlyEmpty: Nothing in this category has been changed from its default.

empty.category: No settings in this category yet.

loadError.title: Could not load the platform settings
loadError.hint: The workspace service did not answer. Try again in a moment.

publish.healthyTitle: Last published {when}. Services pick up a change within seconds.
publish.never: Nothing has been published yet; services run on their deploy-time values.
publish.unhealthyDetail: The last publish did not reach the services: {error}. What you save is stored safely, but services keep running on the values they last received until a publish succeeds.

toolbar.readOnly: Read-only: your role can view platform settings but not change them.

export.done: Exported {count, plural, one {# value} other {# values}} to {file}.
export.excluded: {count, plural, one {# sensitive setting was} other {# sensitive settings were}} left out: {keys}.

badges.riskyHint: Can lock people out, stop meetings or change what customers pay. A change needs a written reason and a diff confirmation.
badges.securityHint: Part of Security & auth: changing it needs the settings.security permission on top of settings.manage.
badges.restartHint: Read once at start-up: a change applies after the owning service is next rolled out.
badges.sensitiveHint: Identifies people: left out of exports and shown as hidden in history.

refusal.manage: Changing platform settings needs the settings.manage permission.
refusal.security: Security & auth settings need the settings.security permission as well.
refusal.server: The server does not allow you to change this setting.

row.noOverrides: No overrides: every plan and workspace uses the platform value.

editor.itemPlaceholder: Type an entry and press Enter (or paste a list)

flag.killSwitchHint: The kill switch. Off turns the feature off everywhere, whatever the lists below say.
flag.rolloutHint: Share of workspaces that get it, chosen by a stable hash of the workspace id. Platform-wide decisions need 100%.

validation.pattern: Is not in the expected format.
validation.flagEnabled: A flag needs to be on or off.
validation.flagRollout: Rollout must be a whole percentage from 0 to 100.
validation.flagPlanSlugs: Plans must be listed by slug (lowercase letters, digits, - and _).
validation.planSlug: Enter a plan slug: lowercase letters, digits, - and _.
validation.scopeNotAllowed: This setting cannot be overridden at that scope.

confirm.title: Review change
confirm.resetExplain: Removes the stored value: {service} falls back to its deploy-time value, then to the code default ({value}).
confirm.riskyNotice: This setting is marked risky: it can lock people out, stop meetings or change what customers pay. Check the new value before you save.
confirm.securityNotice: A Security & auth setting. The change is recorded with your name and reason.
confirm.restartNotice: {service} reads this at start-up: the new value applies after its next rollout.
confirm.unchanged: Nothing to save: the new value is the one already stored.
confirm.reasonRequired: Required, at least {min} characters. Recorded in the setting’s history and the audit log.
confirm.reasonOptional: Optional. Recorded in the setting’s history and the audit log.
confirm.forbidden: You do not have permission to change this setting.
confirm.conflict: Someone else changed this setting after you opened it. Reload to see their value, then make your change again.

override.description: an override wins over the platform value for one plan or one workspace (a workspace override wins over a plan one).
override.workspaceHint: The id is shown on the workspace’s admin page.

history.title: History
history.error: Could not load this setting’s history.
history.empty: No changes recorded for this setting yet.
history.revertDescription: Restores the value this change replaced. The revert is recorded as a new change with your reason.

import.title: Import platform settings
import.description: Upload a file exported from this console. Nothing changes until you apply, and the import is all-or-nothing.
import.excluded: The file left out {count, plural, one {# sensitive setting} other {# sensitive settings}} ({keys}); they are not changed.
import.hasRejected: Fix or remove the rejected lines before applying: the import is all-or-nothing, so nothing would change.
import.nothingToApply: Every value in the file already matches; there is nothing to apply.
import.reasonPlaceholder: Why are these settings being imported?
import.reasonHint: Required, at least {min} characters. Recorded against every change.
import.applied: {count, plural, one {# setting changed} other {# settings changed}}.
import.notApplied: The server did not apply the import; check the lines below.
import.previewFailed: The server could not check this file.

errors.fileTooLarge: The file is larger than 2 MB; that is not a settings export.
errors.invalidJson: The file is not valid JSON.
errors.notAnObject: The file is not a settings export (expected a JSON object).
errors.wrongFormat: The file’s format is “{format}”, not a WarpTalk platform settings export.
errors.tooManyEntries: The file has more than {max} entries.

entryReasons.scopeId: has a scope id that does not fit its scope.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.unknownHint: No service has reported on this integration yet.
integrations.error: Could not load the integration status.
integrations.unavailable: This server does not report integration status yet.
integrations.secretsNote: Keys, tokens and endpoints are never shown or stored here: they stay in deploy configuration, and only whether they are set is reported.

deployConfig.title: Deploy configuration
deployConfig.description: Read from each service’s deployment. Changing one of these needs a deploy, not this console.

retention.intro: Nothing here is a setting yet. A retention setting is added to the registry together with the job that enforces it — until then, a value typed here would be believed and ignored.

transcripts.title: Transcripts, summaries and meeting artifacts
transcripts.body: Kept until someone deletes them. No job removes them by age.

recordings.title: Meeting recordings
recordings.body: Kept in object storage until deleted. No lifecycle rule or job expires them.

auditLog.title: Audit log and settings history
auditLog.body: Append-only. Nothing prunes either of them.

workspaceRetention.title: Per-workspace artifact retention
workspaceRetention.body: A workspace’s artifact retention (days) is stored and shown in its settings, but no job reads it: it is not enforced.

streamTtl.title: Live meeting pipeline streams
streamTtl.body: Redis streams expire after the TTL each service is deployed with. It is deploy-time configuration, not a setting here.

retention.footnote: Deleting data today is a manual action: a workspace owner deletes a meeting or document, or staff act on a request.
